content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Mobile

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour thresholds for your background—typically a bachelor's degree plus documented project hours, or equivalent experience. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can clarify your standing before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend instructor-led sessions online on a schedule that fits your work and life in Mobile. You'll cover the PMBOK Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world application—all required by PMI.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Once training is complete, apply directly to PMI with your education and experience documentation. Pay the associated PMI exam fee at that time. Our team guides you through the application portal and answers questions about your eligibility before you submit.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides targeted exam-prep resources, practice questions, and study strategies to build your confidence. Schedule your proctored PMP exam when you're ready. Our instructors remain available to review challenging topics before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning the PMP, you'll renew every three years by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs). Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses and webinars to keep your credential active and your skills current throughout your career.
